li_projects.title: LinkApp
li_projects.description: LinkApp is a social networking app designed to make planning and joining events simple, fun, and engaging. Built with React Native, Supabase, and Gluestack UI, it combines sleek design with real-time features and AI-driven recommendations.

li_projects.title: CleanRoute
li_projects.description: A health-aware navigation web app that helps pedestrians find walking routes with the lowest air pollution exposure, not just the fastest path. CleanRoute combines real-time air quality data with geospatial routing to enable cleaner, healthier urban travel decisions.

li_projects.title: ResumeHub
